10863: Sebastian Michaelis is the series' antihero. He is the butler of the Phantomhive household and acts as Ciel's bodyguard, two jobs he is completely devoted to.
12531: The Phantomhive family has, for years, been well known for making toys and sweets for small children. However, they are also the Queen's watchdogs; the Phantomhive family keeps an eye on black market dealings in ways that Scotland Yard isn't able to.
12960: Grell is Madam Red's somewhat ineffectual butler. Mostly, she tends to hang around the edges of the scene, fretting over the socially unacceptable things that her mistress continually gets up to.
14952: The glasses-wearing maid of the Phantomhive household. Mey-Rin is enthusiastic about her job but extremely bad at it (her main fault being clumsy.) She adds too much soap while washing clothes, trips and shatters the good china, and is generally a gigantic klutz.
14953: Finnian often called Finny, is Phantomhive household gardener. However, it seems every time he tends to the garden it is killed through an accident caused by his clumsiness and overenthusiastic pruning or not noticing that the pesticide container is leaking.
14954: Bardroy, usually referred to as Bard, is the household cook of American descent.
14955: The steward of the Phantomhive household. No one actually knows what Tanaka does around the house, save for sit around and drink tea. His reaction to any situation, no matter how strange, is to merely smile, take a sip of his tea, and chuckle.
14956: Angelina is the widow of the late Baron Barnett, the queen of high society (which has nicknamed her "Madam Red" due to the color of her hair and clothes), and Ciel's aunt.
14957: Known only by his profession, the Undertaker is a mysterious man whose scarred face is never fully visible beneath his long hair and crooked top hat. He occasionally provides information to Ciel.
14958: Lau is originally introduced as the branch manager of a profitable Chinese trading company's English operations, and an acquaintance of both Ciel and Madam Red.
14959: Elizabeth (who demands to be called by the more affectionate "Lizzie") is Ciel's cousin and fiancée. She is the daughter of Ciel's aunt, Frances, and her husband, Marquis Midford. Lizzie is strong-willed and cheerful, with a fondness for cute things.
16733: The 26th child of the King of Bengal, Soma came to England with his butler, Agni, in search of a missing servant from his household. When he was young, he received a palace, complete with attendants, from his parents.
16735: Soma's highly-dedicated butler, Agni comes with his master to England in search of Meena. Agni is a master at Indian cooking, and has even shown some skill in landscaping (turning the bushes in the Phantomhive Manor's garden into topiary elephants, for instance).
16736: He was the head of the Phantomhive family and handsome enough to attract the attention of both Rachel and her sister Angelina, though he favored the older, more refined sister. It's because of his compliments on her red hair that Angelina originally began wearing red.
16737: Ciel's mother was patient and kind, with an elegant kind of poise occasionally shattered by her propensity to tease her younger sister into being more self-confident. She cared deeply for Angelina and took care of her after her accident.
17192: William is a supervisor in the Dispatch Managment Division of the Death Gods. He appears in the 12th chapter of manga (or in the 6th episode of anime) to pick up Grell Sutcliff. William is emotionless and generally calm.
17648: One of Lau's girls from his opium den. He introduces her to Ciel and company as "his little sister, though not by blood." Ranmao almost never speaks and seems entirely unflappable. But she's not as harmless as she looks...
17657: Joker first appears in the Circus Arc in Kuroshitsuji, and is part of Noah’s Ark Circus which is suspected in the case of the missing children.
17751: Angela is a maid to the Lord Henry Barymore of Houndsworth, though he treats her poorly in public. Finnian initially becomes infatuated with her beauty and seeming gentle kindness... She appears only in the anime adaption.
18228: Viscount Druitt is a Noble that was one of the main suspects for the Jack the Ripper murders. He graduated from Medical School but does not practice medicine.
19070: Drocell is a puppetmaster who aids his boss in the kidnappings of young girls. He uses string as a weapon to strangle his targets. He even appears to be a puppet himself, as some of his reflexes are that of a doll's.
19394: Ghost of Edward V, one of the princes murdered in the Tower of London. (Ep 16)
20008: Ash is the Queen's butler who delivers all of the Queen's request to the Phantomhive Head. His appearance is the exact opposite of Sebastian's, where Sebastian has a black suit and hair color, Ash has a white suit and hair color.
20040: Ghost of Richard, Duke of York, the youngest of the two princes murdered in the Tower of London. (Ep. 16)
20222: Meena was a servant in Prince Soma's household that he looked up to, who was always there for him when his parents couldn't be. An Englishman (revealed to be Lord West) wanted her for his wife, and she left India with him.
20367: She is the queen of the England.
21978: Pluto, also known as the Demon Dog, is a large dog that terrorizes the town of Houndsworth until Sebastian tames him. Afterward, he lives at the Phantomhive Estate. He can breathe fire, walk through barriers and shape-shift into a human. As a human, he retains dog-like qualities.
24800: Ronald Knox is a Shinigami sent to work with William Spears as extra personnel. Ronald appears to be a rather laid back, easy-going Shinigami, who apparently has problems with arriving on time.
25663: Beast appears in the "Noah's Ark Circus" chapters. She is an animal tamer and seems to have feelings for Joker, although she does not show this in public.
25664: Doll appears in the 'Noah's Circus Ark' chapters. She is a tightrope walker, but she also pretends to be a new, male performer called Freckles.
25665: He is the creator of the Noah's Ark Circus and is referred to as Father by the tier-one performers. Except for his left eye, his entire face is covered by bandages. He knew Ciel as a small boy and recreates the room Ciel was branded and caged in as a child.
27337: A Scotland Yard Inspector. In the anime adaption, he is portrayed as one who truly believes in the justice system. He wishes to make London a place where it is safe to have a family and plans to propose to his pregnant girlfriend.
30029: The butler of the Trancy household. He is a demon and he has a line similar to that of Sebastian's, which is "私は旦那様を飽くまで貪りたい" (Watashi wa danna-sama wo akumade musaboritai) which means "I want to greedily devour you to the end, my master.
30030: Earl Alois Trancy is the head of the Trancy household and referred to as " Your Highness" by both his butler Claude Faustus, and his maid Hannah Anafeloz. It is stated that he is 14 years old at the beginning of the story, with the birth date of November 5th.
31513: Hannah is the maid of the Trancy Household. Hannah is loyal to her master, Alois Trancy, and is quite a mysterious woman. She seems to be quite a worried person, and is often seen with her head tilted down as a way of avoiding eye contact with others.
31970: Damian was an owner of the Poseiden Company's Indian factory that makes and supplies stuffed animals for Ciel Phantomhive's Funtom Company. He is a scam artist and is a main antagonist during the kidnapping storyline in the anime.
33287: One of the triplet servants of the Trancy household.
33288: One of the triplet servants of the Trancy household.
33289: One of the triplet servants of the Trancy household.
35348: Snake is a young, relatively skinny male with short white hair with a cowlick, who appears to have small patches of scales all over his body. Snake is quiet, rarely speaking, and when he does, it's usually to relay information from one of his snakes.
36179: Luka Macken is Jim Macken's younger brother. Luka is a lighthearted young child and very supporting of his older brother, saying whatever Jim wishes has to come true.

38812: Azzurro Vanel belongs to the Ferro family, which operates under the trading organization called Ferro Company
38815: Edward Aberline is the twin brother of Fred Aberline, and only appereas in Kuroshitsuji II. He looks very similar to his brother, having shaggy, auburn hair and blue eyes, but, unlike his brother, he has a mustache.
38816: Appears in the Noah Ark's chapters.
38817: Peter works with Wendy as a trapeze artist in the Noah's Ark Circus. Together, they are introduced as the "gasp-inducing flying blanco."
38818: Wendy works with Peter as a trapeze artist in the Noah's Ark Circus. Together, they are introduced as the "gasp-inducing flying blanco."
38819: Dagger is one of the Carnies at Noahs Ark Circus, his Circus trick is a knife Thrower, he never misses his target and uses this to fight. When Ciel joins the Circus as Smile, Dagger helps train him up. Dagger keeps a cheery mood thoughout the manga.
38820: Jumbo is the Noah's Ark Circus fire eater. He starts the shows of the circus with one shot of fire.
38822: Clause is Ciel Phantomhive's uncle who obtains drugs in order to assist Ciel with cleaning out corruption.
38831: Maria is the fiancee of Inspector Fred Aberline. She first appears in episode 22.
38833: John Brown is Queen Victoria's aide and is seen both explaining things on her behalf and working to cheer her up. He is shown to be extremely serious, even keeping a straight face when pretending to be Prince Albert through a hand puppet.
38834: Charles Phipps is a code-named double Charles (the other being Charles Grey), and is a member of Queen Victoria's Private Secretarial Officers, as well as her butler.
59563: Marchioness Frances Phantomhive-Midford is a noblewoman. She is the wife of Alexis Leon Midford, mother of Edward and Elizabeth, sister of Vincent Phantomhive and aunt of Ciel Phantomhive.
75208: Diedrich is Vincent Phantomhive's long-time friend since they were both prefects at Weston College.
78125: Marquis Alexis Leon Midford is the husband of Frances Midford, the father of Edward and Elizabeth, and the leader of the British knights.
79607: Lord Edward Midford is the son of Alexis Leon and Frances Midford, older brother of Elizabeth Midford, nephew of Vincent Phantomhive and older cousin of Ciel Phantomhive. He's attending Weston College, and is member of Green Lion dormitory.
